$comment: docs/risk-tiers.md in a form a program can read. The document is authoritative: this file copies its tier table (name, path globs in the table's order, and the merge-on-green-CI-alone answer) and tests/test-risk-config.sh fails when the two disagree or a glob matches no tracked path. Nothing else in the repository reads or enforces this file; the tiers stay advisory. A change spanning tiers takes the highest tier it touches (highest_tier_wins). This file is itself Tier 3, because a program that read it to decide merges would be widened by editing it.

tiers.name: Load-bearing prose
tiers.merge_condition: the doc-path suite is green and a human has read it
